mapper.select: select * from customer_order where is_delete=0 and is_cancel=0 and order_no=#{orderNo}

SELECT r.biz_no AS bizNo, -- 退款申请流水 r.status AS status, -- 状态 SUM(CASE WHEN d.subject_no = '202' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refundDepositAmount,
SUM(CASE WHEN d.subject_no IN ('101','300') THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refundBusinessIncomeAmount, r.order_desc AS refundReason, -- 退款原因 r.finish_time AS refundTime , -- 退款完成时间, r.fail_msg AS failMsg -- 退款完成时间
FROM customer_order r JOIN customer_order_detail d ON r.order_no = d.order_no WHERE r.source_order_no = #{orderNo} AND r.sub_type = 3001 GROUP BY d.trans_no ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
select distinct biz_no from customer_order where is_delete=0 and is_cancel=0 and project_no=#{projectNo} order by id desc
